_doc.summary: Shape of the synthetic field-visit operation. Seed, dates, volumes, staff counts and paths live in .env; everything the generator draws from is here. Weights are relative (they need not sum to 1). Times are local Dubai time. Assumption numbers (S1..S15) refer to docs/DATA.md.
_doc.geo.max_resample: Draws allowed when placing a point on land in its area's emirate before the generator gives up (see service_area.geojson).
_doc.volume_noise_sd_factor: Daily order count = round(gauss(mean, factor * sqrt(mean))), floored at 0.
_doc.slot_hour_weights: Hour of day (0-23) -> weight for the requested slot start. Peaks 07:00-10:00 and 16:00-18:00 (S7).
_doc.slot_minute_weights: Minute past the hour -> weight. Slots sit on a quarter-hour grid.
_doc.lab_cutoff_margin_min: A sample order's slot is redrawn until slot_start is at least this many minutes before its lab closes, so the day can still end with a lab drop.
_doc.slot_max_redraws: Cap on those redraws; exceeding it is an error.
_doc.lead_time_h: Buckets for hours between published_at and slot_start: [min_h, max_h, weight]; uniform inside a bucket (S8).
_doc.publish_hour_weights: Hour of day (0-23) -> relative chance a patient books then. A drawn lead time is accepted with chance weight/max_weight, else redrawn, so most orders are published in waking hours and only a minority overnight (S8).
_doc.lead_max_redraws: Cap on those redraws; exceeding it is an error.
_doc.patients.repeat_share: Chance an order comes from an existing patient (chosen in proportion to their past orders) instead of a new one; a repeat patient keeps their location.
_doc.supplies.prep_cutoff_hour: Orders for services that need office supplies are 'supplies_ready' when published before this hour on the day before the slot (S12). Services that need none are always ready.
_doc.competitor_claim_min: Minutes after publishing until another provider takes an order nobody has accepted: triangular(lo, hi, mode) (S13).
_doc.cancellation: Chance an order is cancelled = base_rate * lead_multiplier(lead bucket) * service_multiplier(category) (S10). cancelled_at falls between published_at and slot_start, at a fraction drawn from fraction_range of that span.
_doc.staff.nurses_iv_certified_share: Share of nurses who may serve IV services.
_doc.staff.rest_day_weights: Fixed weekly rest day per staff member, drawn from these weights (S3).
_doc.availability: Per staff-day: rest on the rest day; otherwise sick with p_sick or on leave with p_leave. known_at: sick calls arrive the same morning (hour range) or the evening before; leave and rest days are known days ahead.
_doc.events: car_breakdown: chance per active car-day, hour range for 'at', chance it lasts all day, otherwise duration range in minutes. late_start: chance per available staff-day, hour range for 'at', delay range in minutes (until = at + delay).
